cards.english_title: Lee Inspects South Korea’s Rural Basic Income Test
cards.korean_desc: 이재명 대통령은 10월 31일 경북 시범사업을 점검했다. 농촌 주민은 매달 15만 원 상품권을 받는다. 인구감소 지역 69곳 중 17곳이 시행 중이다. 이재명은 SNS에서 영양과 청송 주민에게 인사했다.
cards.english_desc: President Lee Jae Myung inspected a rural pilot program in North Gyeongsang Province on October 31. The program gives rural residents 150,000 won monthly through local gift vouchers. Of 69 population-declining counties, 17 are currently running the pilot. Lee also greeted residents of Yeongyang and Cheongsong counties in a social media post.
cards.hook: Lee inspected a rural basic income pilot.
cards.takeaway_english: The next question is whether temporary vouchers create lasting reasons to stay.
cards.takeaway_korean: 다음 과제는 주민이 계속 머물 이유다.

why_it_matters.english: The pilot tests a direct response to shrinking rural populations.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 시범사업은 농촌 인구 감소에 대응한다.

why_it_matters.english: Gift vouchers may send more spending to local businesses.
why_it_matters.korean: 상품권은 지역 상점 소비를 늘릴 수 있다.

parties.label: Lee Jae Myung
parties.english: He visited North Gyeongsang Province and inspected the pilot program.

parties.label: Rural residents
parties.english: Residents in selected counties receive monthly local gift vouchers.
parties.korean: 선정 지역 주민은 매달 상품권을 받는다.

parties.label: The government
parties.english: It is testing whether local spending can support shrinking rural communities.

views.label: The Lee government
views.english: The program is meant to support rural areas facing population decline.
views.korean: 이 정부는 인구 감소 농촌을 돕는다고 본다.

views.label: Critical perspective
views.english: Available coverage gives few detailed objections, so the program’s long-term results remain unclear.
views.korean: 비판 의견은 적어 장기 결과가 불분명하다.

disagree.english: Some may question whether vouchers alone can reverse population decline, but the available coverage gives no firm answer.

cards.english_title: Samsung and OpenAI Plan Their Next AI Move
cards.korean_desc: 양측은 AI와 경영, 새 사업 기회를 논의했다. 협력은 이제 칩, 인프라, 업무 서비스로 넓어졌다. 삼성은 2027년 2월까지 전 직원 교육을 끝낼 계획이다.
cards.english_desc: They discussed AI’s future, management decisions, and new business opportunities. The partnership now covers chips, infrastructure, and workplace services. Samsung aims to finish AI training for all employees by February 2027.
cards.hook: Samsung executives met Sam Altman about AI.
cards.takeaway_english: The partnership is moving from chips toward everyday workplace systems.
cards.takeaway_korean: 두 회사의 협력은 일상 업무로 넓어지고 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Samsung plans to train every employee by February 2027.
Workplace AI may change how employees manage data and make decisions.
why_it_matters.korean: 업무용 AI는 데이터 관리와 결정을 바꿀 수 있다.

parties.label: Samsung Group
parties.english: It is training executives and expanding AI across its businesses.
parties.korean: 삼성은 임원 교육과 AI 확대를 추진한다.

parties.label: OpenAI
parties.english: OpenAI is supplying enterprise tools and discussing wider infrastructure cooperation.

parties.label: Samsung employees
parties.english: Employees are expected to receive broader access to workplace AI tools.
parties.korean: 삼성 직원은 업무용 AI를 더 사용한다.

views.label: Samsung
views.english: AI could reshape management decisions, organization, and new business creation.
views.korean: AI가 경영과 새 사업을 바꿀 수 있다.

views.label: OpenAI
views.english: Enterprise deployment can improve productivity across technical and non-technical work.
views.korean: 기업용 AI는 여러 업무의 생산성을 높일 수 있다.

disagree.english: The meeting shows plans and training, but it does not prove that AI has already improved Samsung’s results.
disagree.korean: 회의와 교육만으로 성과를 증명할 수 없다.

cards.english_title: Why Sleep Now Comes With a Luxury Price Tag
cards.korean_desc: 명품 침구와 잠옷이 취침을 고가 생활시장으로 바꾼다. 아이더다운은 아이슬란드 둥지에서 새끼가 떠난 뒤 손으로 모은다. 크라운구스 침구는 약 3천만 원이며 특별판은 3억 2천만 원이다. 고급 잠옷 시장은 2024년 137억 달러에서 2032년 222억 달러로 커질 전망이다.
cards.english_desc: Luxury bedding and sleepwear are turning bedtime into a high-priced lifestyle market. Eiderdown is scarce because it is gathered by hand after ducklings leave Icelandic nests. Crown Goose sells bedding for about 30 million won, including a 320 million won edition. The luxury sleepwear market is projected to grow from 13.7 billion dollars in 2024 to 22.2 billion by 2032.
cards.hook: Luxury sleep now includes million-won bedding.
cards.takeaway_english: Luxury brands are selling sleep as both comfort and identity.
cards.takeaway_korean: 명품 브랜드는 잠을 편안함과 정체성으로 판다.

why_it_matters.english: Sleep products are becoming another place where luxury brands compete.
why_it_matters.korean: 수면용품도 명품 브랜드의 경쟁장이 되고 있다.

parties.label: Crown Goose
parties.english: The bedding brand sells eiderdown sets costing about 30 million won.

parties.label: Luxury fashion brands
parties.english: Dior and The Row sell silk or satin sleepwear at luxury prices.
parties.korean: 디올과 더 로우는 고가 잠옷을 판다.

parties.label: Wealthy consumers
parties.english: They are the customers able to buy expensive bedding and sleepwear.
parties.korean: 부유한 소비자가 비싼 침구와 잠옷을 산다.

views.label: Luxury brands
views.english: Rare materials and craftsmanship make high prices part of the product’s appeal.
views.korean: 희귀 소재와 장인 기술이 가격을 높인다.

views.label: Practical sleep view
views.english: Silk and breathable fabrics can help regulate body temperature during sleep.
views.korean: 실크와 통기성 소재는 체온 조절을 돕는다.

disagree.english: The evidence describes luxury products and brand claims, not proof that expensive bedding guarantees better sleep.
disagree.korean: 비싼 침구가 더 좋은 잠을 보장한다는 증거는 없다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 더 잘 자려고 돈을 더 쓸까요?

cards.english_title: Kia’s Lineup Gamble Forces a Decisive Game Five
cards.korean_desc: KIA 타이거즈는 10월 30일 4차전에서 삼성을 4-2로 이겼다. 이범호 감독은 김도영, 해럴드 카스트로, 나성범을 앞에 배치했다. KIA는 7회 세 점을 내 11월 1일 5차전을 만들었다. 승자는 11월 3일 한국시리즈 1차전에 진출한다.
cards.english_desc: The Kia Tigers beat the Samsung Lions 4-2 in Game 4 on October 30. Manager Lee Bum-ho moved Kim Do-yeong, Harold Castro, and Na Sung-bum higher in the lineup. Kia scored three seventh-inning runs, forcing a deciding Game 5 on November 1. The winner will advance to the Korean Series, whose first game is scheduled for November 3.
cards.hook: Kia changed its lineup, then forced Game Five.
cards.takeaway_english: Kia survived one elimination threat, but Samsung still has the series lead.

why_it_matters.english: One game now decides which team reaches the Korean Series.
The game shows how postseason managers react under pressure.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 경기는 감독의 압박 대응을 보여준다.

parties.label: Kia Tigers
parties.english: Kia moved its sluggers up and won Game 4 by 4-2.

parties.label: Samsung Lions
parties.english: Samsung still leads the best-of-five series 3-2 after Game 4.

parties.label: Chris Paddack
parties.english: He started Game 4 on three days’ rest after losing Game 1.
parties.korean: 패닥은 1차전 패배 뒤 사흘 휴식으로 선발했다.

views.label: Kia manager Lee Bum-ho
views.english: The Tigers could not wait for the No. 2 spot to improve.
views.korean: KIA는 2번 타순의 회복을 기다릴 수 없었다.

views.label: Samsung manager Park Jin-man
views.english: Samsung believed its pitchers could keep runners from reaching Kim Do-yeong.
views.korean: 삼성은 투수들이 김도영 앞 주자를 막는다고 봤다.

disagree.english: Lineup changes can create chances, but the final result also depends on pitching and timely hits.
disagree.korean: 타선 변화만으로 승리를 설명할 수는 없다.

cards.english_title: Boynextdoor Takes Its First Tour Across North America
cards.korean_desc: 6인조 그룹은 미국, 캐나다, 멕시코에서 공연한다. 북미 일정에는 댈러스, 플로리다, 시카고, 뉴욕, 토론토가 있다. 북미 뒤에는 2027년 1월까지 아시아 6곳을 돈다.
cards.english_desc: The six-member group will perform across the United States, Canada and Mexico. The North American leg includes Dallas, Florida, Chicago, New York and Toronto. After North America, the group will continue touring six Asian regions into January 2027.
cards.hook: Boynextdoor begins its first North American tour.
cards.takeaway_english: The North American leg is the group’s biggest international test so far.
cards.takeaway_korean: 북미 공연은 지금까지 가장 큰 해외 시험이다.

why_it_matters.english: More fans can experience the group’s music outside Asia.
why_it_matters.korean: 아시아 밖 팬들도 그룹 음악을 직접 경험할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The tour tests how far the group’s audience has grown.

parties.label: Boynextdoor
parties.english: The six-member group begins its first North American concert run.

parties.label: KOZ Entertainment
parties.english: The agency announced the tour and its schedule.

parties.label: Fans
parties.english: Fans in the United States, Canada and Mexico can see the group live.
parties.korean: 미국, 캐나다, 멕시코 팬들이 공연을 볼 수 있다.

views.label: Boynextdoor
views.english: The members say visits to the United States brought meaningful memories and inspiration.
views.korean: 멤버들은 미국 방문이 좋은 기억과 영감을 줬다고 말했다.

views.label: Official tour schedule
views.english: The tour covers ten North American cities from Dallas to Mexico City.

disagree.english: The schedule confirms concerts, but it does not show how large the audience will be.

cards.english_title: Ukraine Talks Await Middle East Developments
cards.korean_desc: 러시아는 날짜가 없다고 했고 젤렌스키는 아부다비를 바랐다. 제안된 형식은 러시아, 우크라이나, 미국의 세 나라다. 10월 29일 러시아는 유럽 협상가를 고려하지 않는다고 했다.
cards.english_desc: Russia said no date was fixed, while Zelenskyy hoped for November 6 to 10 in Abu Dhabi. The proposed format includes Russia, Ukraine and the United States. As of October 29, Russia said European negotiators were not being considered.
cards.hook: The next Ukraine talks may depend on the Middle East.
cards.takeaway_english: No meeting date is fixed, and the format itself remains disputed.
cards.takeaway_korean: 회담 날짜는 없고 참여 방식도 여전히 논쟁 중이다.

why_it_matters.english: A delay keeps diplomacy uncertain during a conflict that has lasted four and a half years.
why_it_matters.korean: 회담 지연은 4년 반 이어진 전쟁의 외교를 불확실하게 만든다.

why_it_matters.english: The participants could shape how any ceasefire discussion moves forward.
why_it_matters.korean: 참여국은 휴전 논의의 방향에 영향을 줄 수 있다.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: It has not proposed a specific date for the next talks.
parties.korean: 러시아는 다음 회담의 구체적 날짜를 제안하지 않았다.

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: President Zelenskyy hopes for talks in Abu Dhabi from November 6 to 10.

parties.label: Europe
parties.english: Britain, Germany and France say Europe should play a role.
parties.korean: 영국, 독일, 프랑스는 유럽도 역할을 해야 한다고 했다.

views.label: Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov
views.english: The Middle East conflict and battlefield situation make near-term talks uncertain.
views.korean: 중동 전쟁과 전장 상황 때문에 가까운 회담은 불확실하다고 했다.

views.label: Ukraine and European leaders
views.english: A meeting should continue, and Europe should not be left outside negotiations.
views.korean: 회담은 계속돼야 하며 유럽이 협상에서 빠지면 안 된다고 했다.

disagree.english: Russia emphasizes timing and a three-country format, while Ukraine and Europe seek broader participation.
disagree.korean: 러시아는 시기와 세 나라 형식을 강조하고 우크라이나와 유럽은 참여 확대를 원한다.
